notes.title: Update 1.0.7 is online.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,  
Thank you very much for your kind patience during the past couple of weeks while waiting for us getting the updates ready. Also, thank you for reporting bugs and suggesting  useful features.
Most of them implemented to the game in this version :
- Intro video skip ( Esc )
- Switch between Right click and Left Click for attacking enemies ( available in game launcher, just before playing game select "change settings and play" and then check "Switch Attack / Run buttons".
- Also resolution and texture quality settings are included in to the game launcher.
But this is not all, 
- Many bug fixed
- Updating balance
- Core game Stability
- Characters sound effects
- GUI updates
and etc...
Please send your feedback to our technical team at Support[@]sourenagames.com
